scope: Men's IPL seasons 2008–2026, T20 World Cups 2007–2026, ODI World Cups 1992–2023, plus the two preserved 1979/1983 classic squads. IPL began in 2008; there is no 2007 season. Only World Cup years are offered. Current means editions held by 2026-10-25, not future squads. Previously released snapshots remain unchanged.

roleMethod: Single draft positions are game classifications, using published squad categories and player profiles, with curated opening options. For older profiles without a role, career batting and bowling figures guide the game classification. Existing card ratings/roles are unchanged; new cards reuse the highest existing rating for that person, or a neutral game rating of 80 for new cricketers. Ratings are not official rankings or historical performance measurements.
latestSnapshot: T20 2026 uses the ICC consolidated final-squad announcement (including its updates), not an end-of-tournament playing XI. Later replacements in ICC team pages are used only to verify player roles, not to alter that announced pool. IPL seasons use archived season squads.
attribution: Roster facts and profile facts were cross-checked against ICC, IPL/franchise publications and linked historical archives. Wikipedia source pages are credited individually below and linked per squad; Wikipedia text is available under CC BY-SA 4.0. No article prose is included in the game catalog. IPL.com is an independent secondary source, distinct from the official IPL site iplt20.com.
